```yaml
name: Docker Build and Test

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'build/docker/**'
      - '.github/workflows/docker-build-test.yml'
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags:
      - 'v*.*.*'

jobs:
  docker-build-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Docker Buildx
      uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v1

    - name: Login to Docker Hub
      uses: docker/login-action@v1
      with:
        username: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }}
        password: ${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}

    - name: Build and test Docker image
      run: |
        DOCKER_IMAGE=${{ secrets.DOCKER_IMAGE }}
        DOCKER_TAG=${{ github.sha }}
        docker build --pull --cache-from $DOCKER_IMAGE:$DOCKER_TAG --cache-to $DOCKER_IMAGE:$DOCKER_TAG:latest --target test -t $DOCKER_IMAGE:$DOCKER_TAG .
        docker run --rm $DOCKER_IMAGE:$DOCKER_TAG pytest

    - name: Push Docker image
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' || startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
      run: |
        DOCKER_IMAGE=${{ secrets.DOCKER_IMAGE }}
        DOCKER_TAG=${{ github.sha }}
        docker build --pull --cache-from $DOCKER_IMAGE:$DOCKER_TAG --cache-to $DOCKER_IMAGE:$DOCKER_TAG:latest -t $DOCKER_IMAGE:$DOCKER_TAG .
        docker tag $DOCKER_IMAGE:$DOCKER_TAG $DOCKER_IMAGE:${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
        docker push $DOCKER_IMAGE:$DOCKER_TAG
        docker push $DOCKER_IMAGE:${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
        docker push $DOCKER_IMAGE:latest
```
